name: Fundamentals
description: Core React concepts, virtual DOM, rendering model, React philosophy, advantages, limitations, and comparisons with other frameworks.

name: JSX
description: JSX syntax, expressions, rendering rules, fragments, conditional rendering, lists, keys, and JSX-specific behavior.

name: Components
description: Functional components, composition, props, component lifecycle concepts, rendering behavior, reusable component design, and communication between components.

name: Hooks
description: Built-in hooks, custom hooks, hook rules, dependencies, lifecycle behavior, hook composition, and best practices.

name: Forms
description: Controlled and uncontrolled components, form handling, validation, React Hook Form, Formik, and form-related patterns.

name: Context API
description: Context creation, providers, consumers, useContext, global state sharing, and Context performance considerations.

name: State Management
description: Local state, useState, useReducer, lifting state up, state organization, derived state, and general state management patterns excluding Redux.

name: Performance
description: Memoization, React.memo, useMemo, useCallback, lazy loading, Suspense, rendering optimization, reconciliation, hydration, and profiling.

name: Routing & SSR
description: React Router, navigation, route protection, code splitting, server-side rendering concepts, and routing-related topics.

name: Architecture & Patterns
description: Application architecture, folder structure, reusable patterns, composition patterns, design principles, testing strategy, scalability, and maintainability.

name: Redux
description: Redux, Redux Toolkit, reducers, actions, middleware, async logic, selectors, RTK Query, and Redux architecture.

name: Other
description: Questions that do not clearly belong to any category above.
